questions.text: Are corridors wide enough and free of obstacles for safe movement?
Is the lighting and signage in corridors and circulation areas adequate?
Are balcony railings at a safe height with appropriate gap sizes?
Do balcony doors have functional childproof locks?
Is the building fully accessible (e.g., reliable lifts, pram-friendly routes)?
Is there adequate surveillance (CCTV or guards) monitoring child areas?
Are play areas highly visible to parents and caregivers?
Is the lighting in outdoor spaces and staircases sufficient for safety?
Are vehicle speeds strictly controlled (e.g., speed bumps, clear signage)?
Are pedestrian paths safely separated from vehicle traffic?
Are designated play areas available and easily accessible?
Is the play equipment safe, age-appropriate, and well-maintained?
Do the outdoor play areas have adequate safety surfacing and shade?
Are there communal spaces (courtyards, community rooms) available?
Are there adequate seating areas that encourage social interaction?
Do the housing units have adequate window sizes and cross-ventilation?
Is the natural daylight inside the units sufficient?
Are lower floors and common corridors free from excessive darkness?
Are noise levels low enough to prevent disruption to children?
Is the housing environment free from severe overcrowding?
Does the environment allow children to safely move around independently?
Is wayfinding easy for children to understand?
Does the estate facilitate frequent play and social interaction with peers?
Are there quiet spaces or dedicated areas suitable for homework?
Does the environment allow for easy parental supervision during routines?
